verdict.rationale: The docs say users can ask Ari 'why spending went up' (cfo-ai-docs-1), which is a period-over-period variance explanation. Ari also proactively tells you what changed (cfo-ai-docs-12, cfo-ai-docs-30), computed numbers trace their lineage back to the source line (cfo-ai-docs-11), and actuals are imported from the ledger (cfo-ai-docs-3). Missing for 10: explicit budget-to-actual variance comparison, documentation of how explanations attribute drivers, and hands-on or independent corroboration of explanation quality.
